title: Understanding PCA
text: Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is a technique used to emphasize variation and bring out strong patterns in a dataset. It projects data onto new axes, called principal components, which are linear combinations of the original variables.

title: Interpreting Scatter Plots
text: Look at the scatter plot with 'mpg' and 'age'. Notice the pattern and how the points are distributed. This can help you determine if other plots might represent similar data.
